name: Low Oxygen Affinity Hemoglobin Disease

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Low Oxygen Affinity Hemoglobin Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Demonstration of hemoglobin with decreased oxygen affinity by oxygen dissociation curve analysis
Positive family history of hemoglobinopathy with similar oxygen affinity abnormalities
Identification of pathogenic mutation in globin genes associated with low oxygen affinity
Presence of secondary erythrocytosis without other causes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of reduced oxygen affinity confirmed by oxygen dissociation curve plus either genetic confirmation or compatible family history
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of erythrocytosis and hemoglobinopathies.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Elevated arterial oxygen partial pressure with low oxygen saturation
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic finding on blood gas analysis
searchTerms: high arterial oxygen pressure with low saturation
discrepancy between oxygen pressure and saturation
elevated oxygen partial pressure but low oxygen levels

pathognomonic.notes: Compensatory increase in red blood cell mass

common.notes: Bluish discoloration of lips and extremities

common.symptomName: Headache related to increased blood viscosity
searchTerms: head pain due to thickened blood

common.notes: Shortness of breath on physical activity
searchTerms: mild shortness of breath with activity

occasional.notes: Enlarged spleen due to increased red cell turnover

searchTerms: neurological events from poor blood flow

laboratory: Oxygen dissociation curve showing decreased P50 (left-shifted curve)
genetic: Mutations in globin genes (e.g., beta-globin gene variants) causing decreased oxygen affinity
other: Family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

distinguishingFeatures: High oxygen affinity causing tissue hypoxia with low P50
Absence of erythrocytosis in some cases
Clonal myeloproliferative disorder with JAK2 mutation
Elevated red cell mass without abnormal hemoglobin oxygen affinity
Presence of methemoglobin causing functional anemia
Chocolate-brown colored blood and cyanosis unresponsive to oxygen

redFlags: Sudden onset neurological deficits suggesting stroke
Recurrent thrombotic events in young patients
references: Bunn HF. Hemoglobin variants with altered oxygen affinity. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2007;2007(1):34-39.
